mapper.insert: insert into student_client( lab_id, student_device_id, host_name, ip_address, status, token, last_heartbeat_time ) values( #{labId}, #{studentDeviceId}, #{hostName}, #{ipAddress}, #{status}, #{token}, #{lastHeartbeatTime} ) on duplicate key update host_name = values(host_name), ip_address = values(ip_address), status = values(status), token = values(token), last_heartbeat_time = values(last_heartbeat_time), updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select id, lab_id as labId, student_device_id as studentDeviceId, host_name as hostName, ip_address as ipAddress, status, token, last_heartbeat_time as lastHeartbeatTime, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from student_client where lab_id = #{labId} order by status desc, last_heartbeat_time desc, id desc
